en.hubeali: H 14838 – Muhammad Bin Ahmad Bin Al-Salt, from Abdullah Bin Al-Salt, from yunus, from Al-Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Muhammad Al-Halby, who has said: I asked Abu Abdullahasws
about the Statement of Allahazwj: “[57:17] Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its death”. Heasws said: ‘The justice, after the oppression’.
en.sarwar: 391. Muhammad Bin Ahmad Bin Al-Salt, from Abdullah Bin Al-Salt, from yunus, from Al-Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Muhammad Al-Halby, who has said: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s.)
about the Statement of Allah (azwj): “[57:17] Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its death”. He (a.s.) said: ‘The justice, after the oppression’.
